assumptions.problem: FICTIONAL ROUND B: Four of five reviewed overdue cases lacked required documents, while one was overlooked. For these invented cases, request readiness is a stronger explanation than missed notifications. This does not establish population prevalence.
assumptions.audience: Operations administrators and approvers in 10 hypothetical pilot teams. The synthetic interviews cover different small samples and are not a population estimate.
assumptions.workaround: Assumed current workflow: administrators check pending requests and manually message approvers. Requesters send missing documents in separate messages.
assumptions.feasibility: Scenario assumption: one engineer, two weeks, existing tested in-app notification service and due-date API. Excludes email/SMS and does not establish real implementation effort.
assumptions.willingness: Unknown. Nobody has committed to adopt or pay. A request for reminders is not evidence that reminders will solve the delay.
assumptions.differentiation: Hypothesis: an in-app reminder adds less overhead than manual chasing. Compare with owner/age visibility and a request readiness checklist. No competitor or preference test completed.

draft.nextActions: Round B proposal: pause a reminder-only build. Test a paper request-readiness checklist with five hypothetical requesters, observe whether required owner/date/documents are included, and record remaining causes of delay. Compare against the current workflow before engineering commitment. Review by 2026-10-30; reconsider reminders if requests are complete but still overlooked.

decisions.final_rationale:
Idea: Approval reminders — synthetic
Description: FICTIONAL DEMO: Add one daily in-app reminder for overdue approval requests in Relay. Compare with an approval status dashboard and a request readiness checklist. Evaluate the next 30 days across 10 hypothetical pilot teams. All numbers and research are synthetic.
Assessment: Assessment incomplete — 4/7 dimensions assessed. Assess the remaining dimensions before comparing the overall opportunity.

Opportunity scores:
  - Problem severity: 4/5
  - Evidence strength: 2/5
  - Market pull: Not assessed
  - Differentiation: Not assessed
  - Monetization clarity: Not assessed
  - Build feasibility: 4/5
  - Strategic fit: 4/5

Key assumptions:
  - Problem: FICTIONAL ROUND A: Administrators spend time chasing overdue approvals. We assume some requests are overlooked; missing request information is a competing explanation.
  - Audience: Operations administrators and approvers in 10 hypothetical pilot teams. The synthetic interviews cover different small samples and are not a population estimate.
  - Current workaround: Assumed current workflow: administrators check pending requests and manually message approvers. Requesters send missing documents in separate messages.
  - Willingness to pay / adopt: Unknown. Nobody has committed to adopt or pay. A request for reminders is not evidence that reminders will solve the delay.
  - Differentiation: Hypothesis: an in-app reminder adds less overhead than manual chasing. Compare with owner/age visibility and a request readiness checklist. No competitor or preference test completed.
  - Feasibility: Scenario assumption: one engineer, two weeks, existing tested in-app notification service and due-date API. Excludes email/SMS and does not establish real implementation effort.

Attached evidence (2; review completed):
  - SYNTHETIC • Missing context challenges reminders (Fictional approver interview exercise A • no real participants) — decreases
  - SYNTHETIC • Missed requests support reminders (Fictional interview exercise A • no real participants) — increases

Risks / unknowns: All evidence and scores are synthetic. Support and conflict remain unresolved. Baseline delay, adoption, willingness to pay, and causal benefit are unknown. Reminder fatigue is a risk.

Next validation actions: Round A decision proposal: do not commit a build. Review five recent overdue requests with administrators and approvers, separate overlooked requests from incomplete requests, and compare a reminder mockup with a paper readiness checklist. Record the cause and next action by 2026-10-30.
